author: NASS
description:
Step back into China in 1947, immediately after World War II, through this beautifully restored and colorized historical film. From bustling harbors and traditional sampans to vibrant street markets, busy city roads, bicycles, rickshaws, jazz dance scenes, and everyday life, this rare footage offers a fascinating glimpse into a nation at a pivotal moment in history.

If you enjoy historical restorations, please like, comment, and subscribe to support future projects.

📽️ Technologies & Techniques Used:
• Advanced video restoration
• New semantic colorization only for the ambiance (not historically accurate)
• Manually colorized keyframes (to establish accurate ambiance and color consistency (not historically accurate)
• Advanced frame reconstruction to FHD
• Manual color corrections 
• Classical restoration workflows (AviSynth ) combined with modern tools for (60fps, stabilization, denoise, cleaning, and deblurring )
• Sound design created for immersive atmosphere

B&W Video Source: M
title: Shanghai 1947: Life After WWII | Advanced Colorization & Restoration (60fps)
